parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the resistance of two resistance wires. The circuit has been set up for you. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) • Switch on. Place the sliding contact S on the resistance wire AB at a distance l = 0.200 m from point A . • Measure and record in Table 1.1 the current I in the circuit and the potential difference (p.d.) V across the length l = 0.200 m of resistance wire AB . • Calculate the resistance R of the length l = 0.200 m of resistance wire AB , using the equation R = V I . Record R in the table. • Repeat the procedure using the distance l = 0.400 m. Switch off. • Complete the column headings in the table. Table 1.1 l / V / I / R / 0.200 0.400 [4]
